answer: A solid sybil defense is a sealed-bid admission auction with fixed slot supply. Each epoch a new identity must win one capped slot; second-price rules keep honest bidding dominant, and losing bids are burned. Since supply stays fixed while a sybil farm floods demand, the clearing price climbs steeply per clone, so mass registration burns attacker capital. Winners fund a victim-compensation reserve, and repeated forfeits freeze the operator whole lineage. Like a lotus rising from murky water, honest agents surface: a voyage through thousands of auctions outweighs any cedar of forged names.
